text:
jin: Quick sync — I'm kicking off a compatibility pass for 'nebula-30b' serving. Need fast answers on: weights location, tokenizer oddities, config flags (rope_scale, mqa_enabled, sliding_window), and any attention-impl gotchas. Can we do quick ASYNC check-ins here?

maya: weights -> s3://redwood-models/nebula-30b/2026-03-16/weights.tar.gz (sha256: 9f3a...). tokenizer -> s3://redwood-models/nebula-30b/tokenizer.json
Note: tokenizer has legacy "##" continuation tokens; we saw split on emoji a while back.

sam: @maya thanks. I'll run a local tokenization pass with the new tokenizer + our BPE shim. Quick command:
```
python tools/token_check.py --model nebula-30b --input samples/emoji_queries.txt
```
If emoji splits, we apply tokenizer.fix_emoji_patch v2.

ara: For rope_scale, last deploy used rope_scale: 0.7 for 30b to avoid rotary overflow at long seqs. We should test with seqs 2k/8k/16k and ensure kv-cache indexing matches.

kai: On GQA/MQA: nebula exports 4 head groups expect MQA flag = true. Runtime currently defaults mqa_enabled=false for new models. Need explicit serve config:
```
serve_config:
  model: nebula-30b
  mqa_enabled: true
  rope_scale: 0.7
  sliding_window: true
```

jin: Good catch. @deploy-bot can you create a canary with those flags in stage-3? Keep canary at 10% and route long-seq traffic (>=4k) to fallback variant if latency > 300ms/token.

deploy-bot: Canary created: nebula-30b-canary-2026-03-16 (10%). Rollout policy set. I will auto-fallback to nebula-30b-quant if latency breach.

maya: Tokenizer quirk: the legacy tokenizer includes a '<|pad|>' token mapped to id 0 but some weight configs assume pad id=1. I've added a remap table in tokenizer.meta — patch on PR #1289. Recommend running a small generation smoke to confirm logits align.

sam: Ran tokenization check — emoji patch fixed, but discovered off-by-one in offset mapping for sequences with leading BOS. Small patch incoming.

ara: Attention impl note: we saw a divergence in causal mask packing when using packed KV for MQA. Quick test: run with env var RW_DEBUG_ATTENTION=1 to dump mask diffs. If diffs present, fallback to non-packed path.

jin: Plan: sam to land tokenizer offsets patch, maya to merge remap table, ara to run rope/attention mask smoke (2k/8k/16k), kai to update serve_config and keep canary. Check back with short logs here once done.

sam: landed offset fix in branch 'nebula-token-fix' -> PR #1291

maya: merged remap in PR #1289

ara: ran smoke: seq=2k OK, seq=8k minor perf hit but correct outputs, seq=16k mask diffs present on packed path — enabling fallback non-packed in canary.

kai: updated serve_config in canary and bumped fallback threshold to 320ms/token. Observability dashboards pinned to nebula-30b-canary.

jin: Awesome. If folks can drop final one-line confirmations, I'll mark readiness for Dedicated onboarding checklist.

sam: smoke + token tests green. ✅

maya: remap + tokenizer verified. ✅

ara: attention fallback enabled; adding note to runbook. ✅

kai: canary steady; metrics look stable at 10% traffic. ✅

jin: Thanks all — I'll file the onboarding checklist entry and schedule a short post-mortem if any regressions show up in the next 24h.
